about: 3X4X web texts in English. Each entry is "Spanish text": "translated text". To make another language, copy this file as lang/<code>.json, translate the right-hand side (the English is there as a guide) and build with 'node build.js <code>'. Keep the HTML tags, the {profile} marks, the $1 / $2 marks and the spaces at the start or end of a text exactly as they are.

page.Ajusta el borde para corregirlo si se co: Adjust the border to fix it if it eats into the game, or use it to cover garbage (ADJUST menu). It is saved automatically.
page.Elige el sistema que vas a usar para que: Choose the system you are going to use so it looks its best. For now the firmware only detects and has been tested with a few.
page.Elige una ranura y guarda en ella lo que: Choose a slot and save what you have now into it, or load what you saved. The chosen slot is also the one that starts at power-on.
page.Exportar guarda la ranura elegida en un: Export saves the chosen slot to a .gbsp file to share it. Import puts it into the chosen slot if it is empty, or into the first free one: it never overwrites. To replace a preset, delete it first.
page.Los presets originales de Rama, para pan: Rama's original presets, for screens that do not accept the modes above.
page.con el preset por defecto, carga 1280×96: with the default preset, loads 1280×960 for NTSC 60 Hz and 1280×1024 for PAL 50 Hz
page.usa toda la altura de la pantalla en ese: uses the full screen height in that preset. Only works with PAL sources
page.El borde quedará guardado automáticament: The border is saved automatically for this console's mode and profile.
page.Si mueves o escalas la imagen, te corres: If you move or scale the picture, it is up to you to save the changes in a personal preset (MODE menu).
page.Los cambios anteriores pueden ocasionar: The changes above can cause conflicts and glitches. Getting a good picture is not easy; readjusting the RAM may help.
page.Ajuste fino: mover y escalar avanzan con: Fine tune: move and scale advance by the smallest possible step. More taps, but exact placement.
page.Si al escalar o posicionar la imagen sur: If graphic errors (glitches, garbage or too much noise) appear when scaling or positioning the picture, changing the RAM speed and/or phase can sometimes fix them.
page.Cada borde por separado, sin cambiar de: Each border on its own, without changing mode on the pad. If you see garbage on one side, first try shifting the memory read or the capture start to push it out of the picture, then close that border. With “fine tune” they all move one by one.
page.corre la imagen dentro de su marco, sin: shifts the picture inside its frame, without moving the frame
page.las líneas en blanco de la memoria: si s: the memory's blank lines: if they show as a black stripe, push them out of the picture
page.desde qué punto de cada línea empieza a: the point of each line where reading the signal starts
page.calibra unos segundos sobre una pantalla: calibrates for a few seconds on a white screen
page.quita el giro sin tocar la saturación: removes the rotation without touching saturation
page.Actúa antes de digitalizar la señal. Úsa: Acts before the signal is digitized. Use it if black arrives raised (composite through a transcoder): the black level above does not reach that far. One or two taps are already noticeable.
page.GBS-Control calibra los offsets del ADC: GBS-Control calibrates the ADC offsets at startup.
page.Si ves los colores desplazados, prueba a: If you see the colors shifted, try turning it off.
page.Este firmware recuerda los ajustes de co: This firmware remembers the color and filter settings for each console separately (only if it has its own profile; I am working on it). Tapping SAVE stores them for the next time you use it, and they become its global setting.
page.Si un juego concreto necesita otros ajus: If a particular game needs other settings (for example, the typical horror game so dark you can't see a thing), don't save here! Save a personal preset for that game in the MODE tab; that preset carries its own colors and filters and won't change the console's global setting.
page.para entradas VGA de PC de 640×480 o men: for PC VGA inputs of 640×480 or less. Scaled they are more compatible with screens, but they can show border or scaling faults. Has no effect with consoles
page.Bloque experimental para reparar la atro: Experimental block to repair the atrocious sync of the ODV-II transcoder (composite to component) when using the PC-Engine. Of no use to other users.
page.Para fuentes con una sincronía débil o p: For sources with weak or troublesome sync (for example, composite converted to component), where the picture jumps every couple of seconds.
page.Sync tolerante: un corte de menos de uno: Tolerant sync: a dropout shorter than about 0.9 s only freezes the picture. The preset is kept and the recovery steps that cause the jump are held back (raising the SOG level, rewriting the coast, freezing and unfreezing). If the signal is really lost, normal recovery still works. Off by default; remembered.
page.SOG +/- cambia el nivel al que se corta: SOG +/- changes the level at which sync is sliced. With a weak or noisy sync tip, another level often holds where the current one fails; it also repeats the phase search.
page.SyncWatcher para y arranca la vigilancia: SyncWatcher stops and starts the watching. While it is stopped nothing is detected (a console change will go unnoticed), and the status bar shows it with “watcher off”.
page.El auto-lock hace solo lo que harías a m: Auto-lock does by itself what you would do by hand: it stops the watcher as soon as the picture reads stable. The button steps through the lock points (off, 2, 10, 30, 62 stable readings): the later, the more settled the picture, so try the highest one it reaches.
page.Mientras cuenta, el vigilante no intervi: While it counts, the watcher stays out of the way: no dynamic adjustments, no SOG optimization, no phase search, because on a weak source that disturbs the picture and resets the count to zero. That is why the higher points were hard to reach.
page.SyncWatcher también sirve para «probar o: SyncWatcher also works as “try again”: releasing the watcher releases the coast, phase and clamp with it, and the count goes back to zero, so a new attempt never inherits the previous state. There is a short pause before it can lock again. If it still isn't right after several attempts, reload the preset to start as clean as possible.
page.El auto-reintento hace los intentos por: Auto-retry makes the attempts for you: it releases the locked state after a few seconds and the next attempt comes by itself. Watch the picture and, as soon as it looks right, press “capture sync”: the attempts stop and that state is saved for this console's profile.
page.Todo lo de este bloque solo actúa sobre: Everything in this block only acts on a console profile that has a saved state (or while auto-retry is looking for one), so a console that already works stays exactly the same.
page.Mientras hay un estado guardado en uso,: While a saved state is in use, recovery no longer overwrites the pulse ignore or the coast, which is what spoiled it on every attempt.
page.El estado guardado se vuelve a escribir: The saved state is written again after every preset load, and “load sync” writes it again at any time. It holds the SOG level, the coast and whether it was left unfixed, the pulse ignore and the phase: what a weak or troublesome source needs and what the watcher would otherwise have to search for from scratch.
page.La receta ODV escribe el estado que se m: The ODV recipe writes the state that was measured working with the PC Engine through an ODV transcoder (SOG level 14, coast 16/256 unfixed, pulse ignore 51), as a starting point instead of nothing. It is not a guarantee: capture it if the picture comes out right.
page.Info de sync escribe el estado actual de: Sync info writes the current sync state to the log, to compare settings while you try them.
page.Mantiene alineados los tiempos de entrad: Keeps input and output timing aligned and fixes the horizontal tear line that sometimes appears.
page.Hay dos métodos. Si la pantalla se queda: There are two methods. If the screen goes black or the picture drifts vertically, try the other one.
page.VTotal + VSST: ajusta el total vertical: VTotal + VSST: adjusts the vertical total and the vertical sync start, for a more precise lock.
page.Solo VTotal: ajusta únicamente el total: VTotal only: adjusts only the vertical total; simpler.
page.Necesita el generador de reloj externo (: Needs the external clock generator (Si5351). Without it, these options do nothing.
page.Seguir a la fuente: la salida va exactam: Follow the source: the output runs at exactly the console's frequency (for example, 59.82 Hz with the PC Engine).
page.59,94 Hz / 60,00 Hz: la salida se queda: 59.94 Hz / 60.00 Hz: the output stays at a standard frequency (50 Hz sources stay at 50 Hz). Useful with capture cards that don't accept odd frequencies. In these modes FrameTime Lock can't follow the source, so a tear line may slowly travel across the picture.
page.Por defecto, el generador de reloj exter: By default, the external clock generator is enabled if it is installed.
page.Puedes desactivarlo si te da problemas c: You can disable it if it causes problems with other options. Needs a restart.
Scanlines not available in this mode.
page.solo con fuentes 240p o con 480i en Bob: only with 240p sources or with 480i in Bob
page.0 es el valor mínimo, no las apaga: 0 is the minimum value, it doesn't turn them off
page.Interpolación vertical: mezcla cada líne: Vertical interpolation: blends each line with the next so they all come out the same thickness. In the x5 modes it turns on by itself so the scanlines fall into place.
page.más contraste en los saltos de brillo ho: more contrast on horizontal brightness steps
page.Al aumentar la nitidez de forma artifici: Raising sharpness artificially creates white halos and makes noise more visible. Blurry signals sometimes benefit, though it will depend on your taste. Try it and decide.
page.Afila los cambios de color: el color se: Sharpens color changes: color is processed with less detail than brightness and tends to bleed at the edges. More level leaves cleaner transitions, but if you overdo it color outlines appear next to the edges. Try it and decide.
page.Solo actúa con fuentes entrelazadas (480: Only acts on interlaced sources (480i / 576i). Motion Adaptive removes the flicker, with some artifacts on what moves. Bob adds no delay and can be combined with scanlines, but it flickers.
page.Limpia el ruido de la señal antes de dig: Cleans noise from the signal before digitizing it. Probably unnoticeable with 240p sources. Not tested with VGA and above.
page.el momento en que se lee cada píxel: the moment each pixel is read
page.Recorre los valores sobre una imagen con: Step through the values on a detailed picture and keep the sharpest one that shimmers least.
page.el GBS crea su propia red: the GBS creates its own network
page.Elige el archivo firmware.bin del proyec: Choose the firmware.bin file of the compiled project (.pio/build/gbsc_en/firmware.bin) and press upload. Don't switch the GBS off until it finishes.
page.Guarda en un único archivo todos los aju: Saves all the GBS-C's settings and presets to a single file, or brings them back from an earlier backup file.
The backup only works for this same GBS.
page.Si sólo quieres exportar/importar/compar: If you only want to export/import/share presets one at a time, do it from the MODE tab.
page.algunos GBS (como el ODV-GBS-C) lo neces: some GBS (like the ODV-GBS-C) need it so that turning right moves down the menu
page.apagado: RGBHV, para cables VGA o conver: off: RGBHV, for VGA cables or HDMI converters. On: component, experimental and not very compatible. Affects every mode
page.muestra el bloque Developer en Avanzado,: shows the Developer block in Advanced, with diagnostic tools
page.OTA permite actualizar por red desde el: OTA lets you update over the network from the computer (PlatformIO). It turns off on restart.
page.¿Volver al borde del firmware? Se borrar: Go back to the firmware's border? The current border for this mode will be deleted
page.¿Reiniciar el perfil de {profile}? Se bo: Reset the {profile} profile? Everything saved in it (colors and filters) will be deleted and it will go back to the factory values. This cannot be undone.
page.¿Sobrescribir el sync guardado de {profi: Overwrite the saved sync of {profile} with the one the chip has now?
page.¿Escribir la receta ODV sobre el sync qu: Write the ODV recipe over the sync the chip has now? The active profile is {profile}.
page.Registros del chip que el firmware no us: Chip registers the firmware did not use: the deinterlacer's (MADPT) and one of the output fields (VDS_HALF_EN). Try them with an interlaced source (480i / 576i).
page.«Siguiente» elige el registro; «−» y «+»: “Next” picks the register; “−” and “+” change its value. Nothing is saved: loading a preset puts them back.
page.Exacta: la salida va a la cifra que escr: Exact: the output runs at the figure you type (for example 59.8245). If the console is more than 1.5 Hz away from it, the output follows the console. As with 59.94 and 60, FrameTime Lock does not act.
page.Reloj del ADC (PLLAD_MD): cuántas muestr: ADC clock (PLLAD_MD): how many samples the chip takes per console line. It is the “PLL divider++” above, but with the exact figure. It changes live; loading a preset puts it back. Careful: some values cut the wifi (it happened to me with 1784 on the PAL Mega Drive).
page.Reloj de salida (Si5351): el que marca l: Output clock (Si5351): the one that sets the output Hz. Useful to look at and to experiment; the output rate steering and FrameTime Lock may move it again.
page.Línea de corte: «fase FTL» mueve el punt: Tearing line: “FTL phase” moves the point where FrameTime Lock places the output against the input (90° from the factory), and the tearing line with it. “Reset memory” restarts the picture memory without reloading the preset. Neither is saved.
page.Cuando la ganancia automática se asiente: Once auto gain has settled and the picture looks right to you, save it for this console. This locks auto gain until you reset it.
page.Olvida la ganancia guardada actual. Reco: Forgets the gain currently saved. Worth doing when you change the cabling or modify the console.

script.Para pantalla 4:3 o 16:9 a elección del: For a 4:3 or 16:9 screen, as the user prefers.

script.Se ven las 224 líneas que usan casi todo: The 224 lines almost every game uses are shown. A border covers the garbage; adjust it by hand if it eats some of the game's pixels or is off-center.
script.Se muestran hasta 240 líneas. Juegos no: Up to 240 lines are shown. Unoptimized games are seen in full.
script.Se ven todas las líneas, ya sean 224 o 2: Every line is shown, whether 224 or 239.
Bars, colorful frames and squashed. That's how PAL used to be. Scanlines not available in this mode.

script.Proporción con la que jugábamos a SNES e: The proportions we played the SNES with on a CRT TV. Non-integer horizontal pixel.
script.Píxel cuadrado en juegos de 256px, proba: Square pixel in 256px games; on the MD you probably want the 320px mode instead.
script.Proporción con la que jugábamos a PCE en: The proportions we played the PCE with on a CRT TV. Non-integer horizontal pixel.
script.Píxel perfecto en juegos 320px de MD, mi: Pixel perfect in 320px MD games, same proportions as on a CRT TV.
Whole pixels, all the same size.
script.Forma de tele de tubo: más ancha, el píx: CRT TV shape: wider, the pixel is no longer whole horizontally (vertically it is).
script.Este modo llena más pantalla, deforma el: This mode fills more of the screen and distorts the aspect. Only for experimenting.
script.Píxel perfecto con toda la imagen. Para: Pixel perfect with the whole picture. For a 16:9 TV.
script.Píxel perfecto a todo lo ancho. Para una: Pixel perfect across the full width. For a TV set to 4:3 mode.
Pixel perfect with the whole picture.
script.Experimental. Píxel perfecto más grande:: Experimental. Bigger pixel perfect: a little of the picture is lost at the top and bottom.
script.Píxel perfecto. Se pierde un poco de ima: Pixel perfect. A little of the picture is lost at the top and bottom. For a 16:9 TV.
script.Píxel perfecto a todo lo ancho. Se pierd: Pixel perfect across the full width. A little of the picture is lost at the top and bottom. For a TV set to 4:3 mode.
For most Dreamcast games. Sharp picture and correct proportions.
script.Para el modo panorámico de juegos como R: For the widescreen mode of games like Rayman 2, F355, MSR... The picture will fill the width of your 16:9 screen.
script.¿No encuentras tu consola? Usa esta opci: Can't find your console? Use this option: it keeps the color, filters, borders and states from the last use. If the picture doesn't fit, try Rama's original presets in the Mode tab. Sharing your measurements and your system's fingerprint will help include it in the next firmware.
script.Elige el sistema que vas a usar para que: Choose the system you are going to use so it looks its best. For now the firmware only detects and has been tested with a few.
script.Perfil sin mediciones, de momento sólo g: Profile without measurements; for now it only keeps the color, filters, borders and states from the last use. If you know how to work out pixel perfect for this system, get in touch with Alexei. Sharing your measurements and your system's fingerprint will help include it in the next firmware.
For a 16:9 TV set to 4:3 mode.
script.Elige un modo de salida, estás viendo un: Choose an output mode, you are viewing a generic preset.
script.Límite del lienzo: a 5 columnas por píxe: Canvas limit: at 5 columns per pixel the picture takes the full width the scaler can draw in 720p.
script.Los bordes negros de los lados están a p: The black borders at the sides are on purpose: they cover the garbage that appears past that limit.
script.La pantalla de la Game Boy queda entera: The Game Boy screen sits whole in the center.
script.Aviso: el modo 16:9 (2 × 2) cambia el re: Warning: the 16:9 mode (2 × 2) changes the sampling clock, and depending on the router's wifi channel it can leave the GBS without a connection.
script.Si pasa, apaga la consola y cambia el ca: If that happens, switch the console off and change the router's channel (11 works). The 4:3 doesn't have this problem.
script.algunas líneas quedan fuera de la panta: some lines fall off the screen. Move the picture to center it to your liking.
script.Al aumentar la nitidez de forma artifici: Raising sharpness artificially creates white halos and makes noise more visible.
script.Señales borrosas a veces se benefician,: Blurry signals sometimes benefit, though it will depend on your taste.
